study_identification.author_journal_year: Joo SW et al., Psychological Medicine, 2023
study_identification.title: Structural variability of the cerebral cortex in schizophrenia and its association with clinical symptoms

study_characteristics.study_objective: To investigate the cerebral cortex structural variability in patients with schizophrenia when compared with healthy controls and to examine their association with clinical variables.

software_tool.answer: R software (ver. 4.0.2; R Development Core Team, Vienna, Austria)

response_variable.answer: surface area, gray matter volume, thickness, and local gyrification index

nm_vldtn_handle_ns.reason: The paper uses ComBat for site effect handling, which is a form of handling nuisance structure. However, the PBSI method itself does not explicitly model nuisance variables.
nm_vldtn_handle_ns.supporting_text: We performed ComBat harmonization to adjust for the variation generated from the use of different neuroimaging datasets with the covariates of age, sex, and diagnosis.
nm_vldtn_handle_ns.location: Supplementary material, ComBat harmonization, outlier removal, and the validation of age and sex matching

nm_vldtn_same_domain_nonindep.reason: The PBSI is calculated within the same group, which constitutes a non-independent validation.
nm_vldtn_same_domain_nonindep.supporting_text: In each group, the cortical structural profile of an individual correlated with the respective profiles of all other individuals within the same group using the Spearman ' s correlation coefficient rho. This process yielded n -1 correlation coefficients per participant, where n is the number of participants in the same group. The correlation coefficients were then averaged to generate the PBSI score for the cortical measures...
nm_vldtn_same_domain_nonindep.location: Methods, Global variability of cortical measures

nm_vldtn_same_domain_indep.reason: No independent dataset from the same domain was used for validation.

nm_vldtn_diff_domain.reason: Data from multiple sites were harmonized and pooled, but no truly external validation on a a different domain was performed.
